admission.justification: The public producer, file storage, lifecycle or native transport owners must preserve this same boundary across their distinct source locations.

applicability: Task-record message storage, leaf-workspace message links, and terminal cleanup or abandon of a workspace messages path.
conditions: Use the narrowest shared canonical task selection.
A real workspace messages directory is moved out with collision-safe preservation before whole-folder removal.
A messages symlink is removed without being followed so no canonical message file is deleted.
exclusions: Developer chat text and native host chat display.
Messages via removed earlier orchestration tools.

Taskless messages use the sender class execution record; during live launch, occupied non-links or divergent links are preserved with warnings, and the directory-only sprint-archive helper preserves a non-link.

evidence: FolderTests (leaf/manager/taskless, link on new and old workspaces, cleanup keeps files) and first-inbound/divergent-link cases (L117-C1-F02); checks-attempt4/pytest-focused.log; worker report Attempt 4

statement: Messages file in the narrowest shared task folder (leaf, else master, else sprint); the leaf workspace links it as messages, terminal cleanup and abandon remove a messages symlink without following it, move out regular files from a real workspace messages directory into canonical notes with collision-safe preservation before whole-folder removal, and never delete a canonical message file of the task or master.
title: Messages file canonically; cleanup unlinks links and moves out real dirs
